children.name: Volvulella acuminata
children.description: Late Miocene. NE Atlantic (Landau et al. 2013). Early Pliocene. NE Atlantic, North Sea Basin (Landau et al. 2013); western Mediterranean (Landau et al. 2011); eastern Mediterranean: Greece (Koskeridou et al. 2017). Early Pleistocene. Central Mediterranean: Italy (Cerulli-Irelli 1910). Recent. Eastern Atlantic, Norway to Angola into Mediterranean (Landau et al. 2013).
